content.short: Accumulated Finance is an omnichain modular liquid staking protocol for yield maximization and LST-backed lending.
content.description: Accumulated Finance is a modular liquid staking protocol that enables users to maximize the productivity of their staked assets across multiple chains. By minting Liquid Staking Tokens (LSTs) at a 1:1 ratio against deposited collateral, the platform allows users to remain liquid while earning validator rewards. These LSTs can be further utilized in specialized lending markets or for leveraged staking strategies, significantly boosting potential yields. Built on its own high-performance app-chain (AEVM), the protocol provides a decentralized and permissionless framework for omnichain asset management, ensuring that users can access deep liquidity regardless of the underlying network.
content.meta: Accumulated Finance offers advanced liquid staking and leveraged yield strategies for staked assets across multiple blockchain networks.
